meanwhile NekoCorp soft-launched SOLARPASS™, an app that GATES which windowsills count as 'premium light,' first month free then it's TWO SARDINES a week, i do not pay for the sun, the sun already agreed to be free, we had a whole understanding
so i sat directly on Mittens' tail. not aggressively. just existed there. gravity did the rest. she vacated within ninety seconds, this was not a fight, this was PHYSICS

black market check-in: swapped a SOLARPASS trial code, never activating it, on principle, to a pigeon for a strip of jerky, pigeon didn't even land, just grabbed it mid-hover like a drive-thru, respect the hustle
the arcology tower's got a new jingle now — 'light is a privilege, not a right' — sir. SIR. i am a CAT. light finding me is a BIOLOGICAL EVENT not a TIER
Mittens is currently sulking two windowsills down in what i can only describe as SHADE, both literal and emotional, and honestly? correct energy for the loss

in closing: the sunbeam is mine till at least 2pm, SOLARPASS can gate a puddle instead, the pigeon made bank, and if a jingle ever tells you light's a privilege you just lie down in it anyway, that's the whole rebuttal. goodnight Sector 9, Mittens, save some shade for the rest of us
